$comment: SITE EDIT FILE FOR THE HOME PAGE AND THE PARTS SHARED BY EVERY PAGE (top bar, navigation, footer, base colours). Groups run from the top of the page downward. Inside a group: the words first, then that text's font and font size, then its colour with its opacity on the very next line. Opacity runs from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Colours are six-digit codes like #3f4d46. Font: 'default' keeps the current look, or type a name from the font list in the README (for example Playfair Display). Font size: 'default', or a size such as 1.5rem or 24px. Keep every comma and quotation mark; check the file with a JSON validator before saving. Notes like this one start with $comment and are ignored by the site.

errors.$comment: WHEN SOMETHING CAN'T BE SHOWN. image: the picture used for any product, colour or category photo that can't be found, and on cards that are Temporarily Unavailable. Put the file in the assets folder next to the roses and write its name here, starting with a slash (change .jpg to .png or .webp if your file is one of those). unavailableText: the words shown on a card or category whose file has a mistake. The mistake itself (file, line and column) is written to the Vercel logs, never shown to visitors. The words' font, size, colour and opacity come next; they are used everywhere the words appear (home page cards, category pages and product cards). homeTilePanel: the pale panel behind the words on a home page card, so they stay readable over the photo.

floatingHeader.$comment: FLOATING HEADER SWITCH. true: the dark top bar and the white bar with both logos and the four links stay at the top of the screen while scrolling (the Cart button sits just under them). false: they scroll away with the page. Write true or false with no quotes.

basePalette.$comment: BASE COLOURS for the whole site. Anything without its own colour below uses these. The cart and each category page can override them inside their own files.

otherButtons.$comment: COLOURS FOR ANY BUTTON THAT HAS NO SETTINGS OF ITS OWN (for example on the page-not-found screen). The cart, payment and category buttons are edited in their own files.

goldBars.$comment: THE GOLD BAR BORDERS on every page: buttons, cards, the navigation bar, footer, page openings, the rose picture's arch, the cart and the Terms/Privacy pages. Each bar looks like a rounded gold rod: lighter on its top and left, darker on its bottom and right. lightColor, middleColor and darkColor are its three golds. There are three thicknesses. large: navigation bar, footer, page openings, product and category cards, the rose arch, the top of the cart and the Terms/Privacy panels. medium: buttons, the scrolling banner and the phone menu. small: divider lines, size buttons and size lists, form boxes and table lines. Each Size is 'default' or a size such as 0.375rem (grows with the shopper's text size) or 6px (always the same); MinSize and MaxSize stop it getting too thin or too thick. The colour circles keep their thin lines, and the thin lines in the cart's item list and Order summary are set in Cart.json.

topBar.$comment: THE THIN BAR AT THE VERY TOP OF EVERY PAGE.
topBar.messageText: Small-batch style, delivered from Asaba · Delta State

navigation.$comment: NAVIGATION BAR AT THE TOP OF EVERY PAGE: both logos and the four links (they slide into a menu on phones).
navigation.$commentLogos: THE TWO LOGO PICTURES at the left of this bar. circleLogoImage is the round G logo; brandLogoImage is the Graceful Fashion wordmark beside it. Each is a path to a picture in the repo, starting with / (for example /assets/gf_circle_logo_clear.png). Transparent PNGs look best. The site shows exactly the picture named here, so check the spelling of the path.

links.$comment: THE FOUR LINKS share one font, size and set of colours.

floatingCartButton.$comment: FLOATING CART BUTTON: the round Cart button near the top right of every page except the cart (it follows the floating header). text = its word. normal = resting, hover = mouse over. countBadge = the small circle with the number of items. Its gold ring is set in goldBars.

hero.$comment: THE BIG OPENING SECTION: small label, big title (the second part is the coloured emphasis), intro, and the rose picture with its note.
hero.introText:
Discover beautiful fragrances, thoughtful hair care, and everyday essentials that turn simple moments into something special.

Note:  We're refreshing our collection. Our checkout is currently in test mode, and real orders and payments are not yet being accepted.
hero.imageAlt: A blush pink rose, the signature flower of Graceful Fashion

marquee.$comment: THE SCROLLING BANNER UNDER THE OPENING SECTION. 'items' are the words that scroll. bannerHeight: 'default' keeps today's height, or type a height such as 3rem.

collection.$comment: HEADING ABOVE THE CATEGORY CARDS, then the cards' shared colours. Each card's words and picture are edited in the Categories folder.
collection.titleText: Find what makes you feel like you.
collection.introText: From a familiar fragrance to a new hair color for a special day, browse the collection at your own pace.

cards.$comment: COLOURS SHARED BY EVERY CATEGORY CARD on the home page. A card file in SiteEdit/Categories that says "default" for titleColor, titleColorOpacity, backgroundColor or backgroundColorOpacity uses these; a card file with its own value there uses its own.

categoryPages.$comment: CATEGORY PAGE STYLE SHARED BY EVERY CATEGORY PAGE. Each category file (SiteEdit/<folder>/<file>.json) has a categoryPageStyle block with the same settings; wherever it says "default", the page uses the value here. A category that has its own value for a setting uses its own value instead, for that setting only. A setting that says "default" here too keeps the site's built-in look. Inside a group: the words first, then font and font size, then colour with its opacity on the very next line. Opacity runs from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Colours are six-digit codes like #3f4d46. Font: 'default' or a name from the font list in the README. Font size: 'default', or a size such as 1.5rem or 24px.

basePalette.$comment: BASE COLOURS for this category page only. Anything without its own colour below uses these.

hero.$comment: TOP OF THE CATEGORY PAGE: the All collections button, then the category title and description (their words are edited at the top of this file).

allCollectionsButton.$comment: ALL COLLECTIONS BUTTON (same look as the cart's Continue shopping button). normal = resting, hover = mouse over.

subcategories.$comment: SUBCATEGORIES (only on categories whose card file in SiteEdit/Categories has a subcategories list). Each subcategory gets a heading with its products under it. When there are two or more, a row of jump buttons sits above the first heading; each one goes to its subcategory and is also a link you can share, such as /category/hair-care#hair-coloring. otherHeadingText = the heading over products that have no subcategory. unavailableHeadingText = the heading of the last group, under More, holding products that are Temporarily Unavailable (it has no jump button). headingLine = the thin line under each heading. jumpButtons: normal = resting, hover = mouse over.

backToTopButton.$comment: BACK TO TOP BUTTON, centred under the cards. On a category with subcategories there is one under each subcategory's cards (the last one is the end of the page); on other categories there is one under all the cards. Pressing it glides back to the top of the page. A button that is already on the first screen when the page opens is not shown, so short pages don't get one. text = the words on the button. normal = resting, hover = mouse over. A colour set to "default" copies the subcategory jump buttons above.

productCards.$comment: THE PRODUCT CARDS. Product names and prices come from the shop database, so only their look is set here.

colorSwatches.$comment: COLOUR CIRCLES (only on products sold in colours). They sit right under the price, centred, and wrap onto a second row if there are many. Each colour's circle colour (swatch) and photo are set in this file's products list, under that colour's id. circleSize and gap: a size such as 1.6rem or 26px. The ring marks the chosen colour; a faded circle with a line through it is sold out in every size (it can still be tapped to see its photo).

shades.$comment: SHADES (only on products where a colour has shades). Each shade's circle colour (swatch) and photo are set in this file's products list, inside its colour, under the shade's id. noteText = the words above the circles. A colour with shades has a small arrow mark on its circle; tapping it opens a menu of its shades, and once a shade is picked the circle takes the shade's colour. chooseShadeText = the Add to cart button's wording until a shade is picked. The menu uses the size dropdown's menu colours below.

sizeButtons.$comment: SIZE BUTTONS (for products with a few sizes such as S, M, L). 'highlight' is the look when hovered or selected. 'soldOut' is the look of a size with none left: it can't be tapped, and its words get a line through them (soldOutLineColor). soldOutFade fades the whole button, gold bar included: 1 = no fade, 0.4 = quite faint.

sizeDropdown.$comment: SIZE DROPDOWN (for products with a longer list of sizes, such as shoes). The same look is used for the cart's State, Town and Pickup menus. 'optionSoldOut' is the look of a size with none left in the menu: it can't be picked, and its words get a line through them. optionSoldOutFade fades the whole option: 1 = no fade, 0.4 = quite faint. Sold-out shades in the shade menu use the same look.

addButton.$comment: ADD TO CART BUTTON. text = normal wording, addedText = wording for a moment after adding, chooseSizeText = wording while a size is still needed. States: normal, hover (mouse over), pressed (just clicked), disabled (size not chosen yet).

gallery.$comment: PHOTO GALLERY CONTROLS, for products with a "gallery" list of extra photos. arrowButtons = the round < > buttons on the product card's photo and in the large photo view (lightbox). dots = the small circles under the lightbox photo, one per photo; the one being shown uses activeDotColor (cards show arrows only). Products without a gallery show none of these. Sizes are a number with rem or px, like "1.8rem" (1rem is about 16px); however small they look, the tap area stays at least 2.25rem.

about.$comment: THE ABOUT SECTION: picture with its tag on the left, story on the right. 'paragraphs' is a list of paragraphs (they share one font, size and colour).
about.titleBeforeText: Scent and hair should make you feel
paragraphs: At Graceful Fashion, we believe getting dressed can be a small, lovely act of self-trust. We curate soft, elegant pieces in fregrent scents, hearty musks, and elegant hair-care products that meet you where you are.
We are a personal boutique label in Asaba, Delta State — here for the days you want to feel polished, comfortable, confident, or simply a bit more like yourself.
about.imageAlt: A pink rose beside the Graceful Fashion story

contact.$comment: THE CONTACT PANEL. 'links' is the list of contact buttons: each has a type, a label (the words shown) and a url. Copy a { ... } to add another. All links share one font, size and colours.
contact.introText: Have a question about a piece, a size, or delivery around Asaba? Grace would love to hear from you.

footer.$comment: THE FOOTER AT THE BOTTOM OF EVERY PAGE (all pages use these words and colours). legalText is the line under the name: words written as [Words](terms) become a link to that page of Legal.json (terms, privacy). Keep the square and round brackets exactly. On the cart page these links open in a new tab, so a half-filled checkout form is not lost. legalColor is the plain words (such as © 2026); legalLinkColor is the link words, and legalLinkHoverColor is the link under a mouse or finger.
